reading: Dormouse numbers in England and Wales may be going up after years of falling.
A dormouse is a small animal like a mouse.
The hazel dormouse is the only kind of dormouse in the UK.
The new figures suggest there were almost 10 percent more dormice in 2025 than in 2020.
But researchers say the real change could be quite different from what these figures show.
There are still almost 60 percent fewer dormice than in 2000.
Dormice sleep through the winter in nests on the ground.
Scientists think dormice may spend less time in deep sleep in warmer summers.
This may leave them with more energy to feed and have young.
People who work to save dormice say we still need to protect the woods where they live.

vocabulary.definition: Numbers that show what people found.
A smaller number of people, animals or things.
Places animals make to rest or have young.
Sleep that is hard to wake up from.
The strength to move and do things.
To keep someone or something safe.
